title: crataegus chrysocarpa var. blanchardii
intro: Crataegus chrysocarpa var. blanchardii, commonly known as Blanchard's hawthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to support cardiovascular health, and its health benefits include lowering blood pressure, improving blood lipid profiles, and reducing the risk of heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus chrysocarpa var. blanchardii are attributed to its ability to relax blood vessels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which contribute to its cardiovascular-protective effects.
